timeline.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

timeline.quote: "Dellian. Have you returned to make that deal with me?"

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: The daemogoth screamed in the moment before glorious life sprang from its head, bursting its skull.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen asks Fel whether he made a deal with the daemogoth, and Fel dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "With that provincial bogeyman? Ridiculous. It has nothing to offer me."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
timeline.quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer

timeline.summary: Fel says the last he saw of the huge archaic it was carrying Jadzi nearby, and leads the group toward the exit.
timeline.quote: The last we saw of that huge archaic, it was carrying Jadzi not far from here.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: "There are no snarls in Titan's Grave. There never have been,"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"
